I'm not interested in changing my preferences just to make you comfortable or to satisfy your definition of "productive." I value the spontaneity of a wandering conversation. If you find that boring, that's your prerogative, but I'm not going to erase my own personality to mirror yours. We can disagree; it's more interesting that way.
